rules.warning: CPT 49000 is generally considered integral to CPT 44005 and is not separately reportable when the exploratory laparotomy is performed to accomplish the enterolysis. Payable estimates have been adjusted accordingly.

rules.reason: Total splenectomy performed only to manage an iatrogenic splenic injury during a related abdominal operation is not separately reportable.
rules.warning: CPT 38100 is a separate-procedure splenectomy code. When splenectomy is performed only to manage an iatrogenic splenic injury during another abdominal operation, it is generally not separately reportable. If the splenectomy was performed for trauma, pre-existing splenic disease, malignancy, abscess, hypersplenism, or a distinct indication, separate reporting may be supportable with documentation.
source_basis: CMS NCCI Policy Manual hemic/lymphatic guidance
